## Change

Problem ID(s), the correction or addition, and why it is needed.

## Mathematical evidence

Primary references with exact locators. For a status change, explain the match
to the original target and any cases that remain open. For rating changes,
explain the decision under the repository rubric.

Distinguish an informal audit (including AI-agent review) from Lean verification.
For `Lean verified`, include the pinned source/toolchain, exact target theorems,
statement correspondence, reproduction commands, verification log and axiom
report described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/ajt60gaibb/OpenProblemsInNLA/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#lean-verification).

## Documents checked

State which affected Markdown/TeX/PDF documents and catalog indexes were updated
and inspected. Note any material access or verification limit.
